zh.title: 巴拿馬航空客機與UPS貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）地面碰撞 兩名乘客輕傷
zh.summary: 巴拿馬航空客機與UPS貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）地面碰撞；兩名乘客輕傷
body: 巴拿馬航空一架B737-800客機與UPS一架B767貨機，於2026年11月14日晚間在佛羅裏達州邁阿密國際機場（MIA）地面碰撞。
AeroTime報導，碰撞發生於當地時間約21時15分。客機剛降落，正滑行前往登機門時，左翼尖撞上貨機機鼻。
巴拿馬航空427號班機從巴拿馬市（PTY）抵達，機上有166名乘客及6名機組員；UPS 358號班機則正準備起飛前往哥倫比亞波哥大（BOG）。
巴拿馬航空表示，客機上兩名乘客在碰撞中受到輕傷，均無須住院。
AeroTime報導，事發後拍攝的照片顯示，貨機機鼻有明顯損傷。

en.title: Copa Airlines and UPS aircraft collide on the ground at Miami International Airport (MIA); two hurt
en.summary: Copa Airlines and UPS aircraft collided on the ground at Miami International Airport (MIA), slightly injuring two passengers.
body: A Copa Airlines B737-800 passenger aircraft and a UPS B767 freighter collided on the ground at Miami International Airport (MIA), Florida, on the night of November 14, 2026.
The collision happened at about 21:15 local time, AeroTime reported. The passenger aircraft had just landed and was taxiing to the gate when its left wingtip struck the freighter's nose.
Copa Airlines flight 427 had arrived from Panama City (PTY) with 166 passengers and six crew members aboard. UPS flight 358 was preparing to take off for Bogota (BOG), Colombia.
Copa Airlines said two passengers aboard its aircraft suffered minor injuries in the collision and that neither required hospitalization.
AeroTime reported that photographs taken after the incident showed significant damage to the freighter's nose.

zh.title: RwandAir尋求擴大空中巴士A330機隊 盼拓展國際航網
zh.summary: RwandAir尋求擴大空中巴士A330機隊，盼拓展國際航網。
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，航空公司 RwandAir 目前正尋求擴大旗下由空中巴士 A330 型飛機組成的機隊規模。舒適度、載運容量與較低成本，是這項機隊擴張構想所涉及的考量。
RwandAir 希望透過擴大空中巴士 A330 機隊規模，進一步拓展自身的國際航線網路，並與航空產業中規模龐大的其他航空公司競爭。

en.title: RwandAir seeks Airbus A330 fleet growth to expand international network
en.summary: RwandAir seeks to expand its Airbus A330 fleet and grow its international network.
body: RwandAir is looking to increase the size of its fleet of Airbus A330 aircraft, according to Simple Flying. Comfort and capacity, as well as the prospect of lower costs, are cited as considerations for the airline's proposed fleet expansion.

The airline hopes that increasing the number of aircraft in its Airbus A330 fleet will help it to further grow its international network and compete with some of the major companies in the airline industry.

zh.title: 日本財務省傳提出五年防衛預算 F-35採購可能受影響
zh.summary: 日本財務省傳提出防衛預算；F-35採購可能受影響，防衛省稱下期計畫規模未定
body: 日本財務省據報提出一項五年期防衛預算，金額低於部分防衛官員預期。路透社引述4名熟悉相關討論的人士指出，這項落差可能迫使部分原定軍機及飛彈採購最多削減50%，F-35戰機也可能受到影響。
報導指出，財務省官員提議自2027年4月起的五年期間，編列50兆至60兆日圓（約3,130億至3,750億美元）防衛支出。日本防衛省發言人表示，下一期防衛整備計畫規模尚未決定，日本將先確認防衛需求，再設定預算。
日本目前計畫採購147架F-35戰機，其中105架為傳統起降型F-35A，42架為短距起飛及垂直降落型F-35B。日本尚未宣佈縮減整體採購計畫。

en.title: Japan's reported defense budget proposal could affect F-35 purchases
en.summary: Japan's reported budget proposal could affect F-35 purchases; the Defense Ministry says the next plan's size is undecided.
body: Japan's Finance Ministry has reportedly proposed a five-year defense budget below what some defense officials expected. Reuters, citing four people familiar with the discussions, reported that the gap could force cuts of up to 50% to some planned aircraft and missile purchases, including F-35 fighters.

According to the report, Finance Ministry officials proposed defense spending of 50 trillion to 60 trillion yen ($313 billion to $375 billion) over five years beginning in April 2027. A Defense Ministry spokesperson said the size of the next defense buildup plan had not been decided and Japan would first determine its defense needs before setting the budget.

Japan plans to acquire 147 F-35 fighters: 105 conventional takeoff and landing F-35As and 42 short takeoff and vertical landing F-35Bs. It has not announced a reduction in the overall procurement plan.
